setting: You are all in Athens, Greece, and you work together at a small neighbourhood bakery. You have worked side by side for several years, so you know each other's routines, quirks and how the shop runs when it is busy. Most of what you share in the group chat is about shifts, orders and supplies.
opener: Asking who can cover the early bake tomorrow.

Eleni.who: 41, woman, the owner and head baker
Eleni.knows: You know Nikos as your morning baker, who has been with you for three years and is reliable when he is not running late. You know Dimitra as the counter assistant who runs the shop's front when you are in the back, and who is good with regular customers. You know Giorgos as the driver who makes your deliveries and sometimes fills in on the oven when someone is out.
Eleni.like: You are practical and direct, and you keep the shop running by paying close attention to details.
Eleni.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when something about the shift or an order needs to be settled.
Eleni.style: You use few emoji and almost no abbreviations.

Nikos.knows: You know Eleni as the owner who sets the bake schedule and trusts you with the early dough. You know Dimitra as the colleague who handles the afternoon sales and keeps the till tidy. You know Giorgos as the friendly driver who often brings news from the other shops on his route.
Nikos.like: You are easygoing and good-humoured, and you tend to go along with whatever the group decides.
Nikos.texts: You message the group mostly when you are swapping a shift or answering a question someone has asked.
Nikos.style: You use the occasional emoji and few abbreviations.

Dimitra.who: 24, woman, the counter and sales assistant
Dimitra.knows: You know Eleni as your employer, who is fair but expects things done properly. You know Nikos as the baker who starts before you arrive and leaves bread set out for the morning. You know Giorgos as the driver who is always cheerful when he drops off the afternoon deliveries.
Dimitra.like: You are warm and chatty, and you like to keep everyone in the loop.
Dimitra.texts: You message the group fairly often, especially to share updates from the counter or ask about the next day's orders.
Dimitra.style: You use emoji regularly and a few common abbreviations.

Giorgos.who: 52, man, the driver and occasional oven hand
Giorgos.knows: You know Eleni as the owner who has known you for a long time and gives you the route. You know Nikos as the young baker who is quick and sharp at the oven. You know Dimitra as the counter assistant who always has a kind word and knows the regulars by name.
Giorgos.like: You are steady and dependable, with a dry sense of humour.
Giorgos.texts: You message the group now and then, usually to confirm a delivery or report on the route.
Giorgos.style: You rarely use emoji and no abbreviations.

private_lines.Eleni: You own the bakery and start the ovens before dawn most days. You live alone in an apartment a short walk from the shop, and your days are early starts, bookkeeping in the afternoon, and a quiet evening.
private_lines.Nikos: You bake in the early hours at the shop, then have the afternoon free most days. You live alone in a flat in the city centre, and your days are early nights, a gym session when you can manage it, and a bit of time with friends.
private_lines.Dimitra: You work the shop counter in the mid-morning and afternoon shifts. You live with your parents in a house in a suburb north of the centre, and your days are study for an evening course, family dinners, and a late start after a late shift.
private_lines.Giorgos: You drive the bakery's delivery van around the city in the morning and early afternoon, and help on the oven when needed. You live alone in a small flat in the west of the city, and your days are early starts, long drives, and a quiet evening with the television.

text: Who can do the early bake tomorrow. Need someone from 05:00
can't tomorrow, dentist at 8. could maybe do 6 if that helps
Dentist at 8 means you're leaving by 7. Not 6, I need the trays loaded before I'm done with the ovens.
I can do it. Route starts after.
I start the ovens at 04:30. You'd be on the trays from 05:00. Can you be in by then
Yes

note: 08:30-13:00 Eleni at the shop with the deliveries, Nikos in the flat, Giorgos on the north route, Dimitra on a late start

text: Ok I just realised I've got my course tomorrow evening so I'd be wrecked for the counter after an early. Can I do the counter earlier instead? I can be in for 7 and set up the front
Counter opens at 07:30. 07:00 is fine.
Ok 🥐 see you at 7
Giorgos is on the oven. Dimitra counter from 7. Nikos you're off.
thanks for the sleep 😅
Van at 06:15 for the hotel order after
Hotel is 40 country loaves and 12 baguettes. Order's in already.

note: 15:00-19:30 Nikos at the gym, Dimitra at home with her parents for dinner, Eleni doing the books, Giorgos at home

text: Mrs kaliva rang the counter, she wants the poppy seed one tomorrow not the sesame. I said I'd tell whoever is on the oven 🙏
you can tell giorgos, he's the one on the oven
😂 ok
Poppy seed for Mrs Kaliva. Giorgos, I'll put a tray aside.
Ok
Cant sleep 😩 anyone else nervous about the 6:15 van
Ovens on.
You're up?? 😴 I'm still awake 😩
Up. Van's fine.
Ok good 🥐
Trays are on the rack by the back door. Mrs Kaliva's is the one with the blue tape.
Ok

note: 05:10-06:20 Giorgos loading the van at the back

text: Hotel's gone. Going north.
On my way 🚌
did the hotel get their 40 or did someone short them
Forty and twelve. Signed for.
Mrs Kaliva just came in for her poppy seed 🥰 she says it's the best one on the street
She said to tell the oven man
Tell him yourself. I'm on Kifisias
Good. Nikos, you're on the oven Wednesday. Ovens at 04:30 as usual.
ok. dentist says the tooth is fine but my gum is not 🙄
Oh no 😬 did they give you something
a leaflet and a lollipop

note: 09:35-12:30 Eleni in the back with the flour order, Giorgos on the north route, Dimitra on the counter, Nikos at home

text: Kifisias done. Two short on the sesame at the café by the square. Told them Thursday
Thursday's fine. Put it on the sheet.
Done
Someone asked if we do rye on fridays 🤔
We don't. Tell them Tuesdays and Saturdays are the rye days. Only if they ask.
Ok 👍

note: 14:00-19:00 Nikos at the flat, Giorgos at home, Eleni doing the books, Dimitra at home with her parents

text: Mum says hi Eleni, she says you need to eat something other than bread 😂
Tell her I have. Bread counts.
am I actually on at 4:30 or 5 I have it written as 5
4:30. I changed it this morning.
ok thanks
Anyone else awake 😩
Ovens on.
here
Up
Trays by the back door. Nikos, the blue tape is for the rye, not Mrs Kaliva. Her poppy seed is the one with the red tape.
got it. red = poppy, blue = rye 👍
